reason: The cited evidence does not support the key premises. E1 uses laser melting deposition on a different, non-equiatomic alloy (Hf0.25NbTa0.25TiZr) with different parameters and does not test oxidation resistance. E2, E3, E4, and E5 are unrelated to laser surface melting, oxidation resistance, or the equiatomic HfNbTaTiZr alloy. No evidence supports the formation of an oxide-free layer, its effect on oxidation, or property preservation.
premises: Laser surface melting creates a dense, oxide-free surface layer on refractory alloys
